children: The Czech Finance Ministry will offer up to 18 billion crowns ($808.59 million) worth of domestic government bonds in auctions in December, it said on Monday.
The ministry added it would also offer up to 2.5 billion crowns worth of short-term Treasury bills, as well as 500 million euros worth of euro-denominated bills.
